character_description: Middle-aged male in his late 30s, rough and resonant voice, straightforward and bold tone, moderate pacing with bursts of enthusiasm, honest and reliable quality, working man warmth underneath toughness. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 搞机械的人讲究实打实，来不得半点虚假。这台老机器的零件咬合严丝合缝，一看就是好手艺。别人看不懂的东西，在我眼里全是宝贝，这就叫术业有专攻！
